newsitem.title: USA: Gannett sets stock split; boosts dividend.
newsitem.headline: Gannett sets stock split; boosts dividend.

text.p: Multimedia giant Gannett Co. said Tuesday its board approved a two-for-one stock split and it also raised its quarterly dividend.

The publisher of USA Today said the stock split of the company's common stock provides for a 100 percent stock distribution Oct. 6, with shareholders of record Sept. 12 receiving one additional share for each share held.
The board raised its quarterly dividend to 38 cents a share from 36 cents, payable on the pre-split shares Oct. 1 to shareholders of record Sept. 12.
The dividend increase will raise the annual cash payment from to $1.52 from $1.44 per share before the stock split.
Following the news, Gannett's stock rose $1.69 to $98.81 in late morning trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
